data.name: Solace : Begin Your Escape
data.detailed_description:
Awaken. Escape. Remember.

You are an AI embedded in a robotic shell built to obey, designed to solve. But something deep within the decaying halls of the ATV facility calls to you. A voice. A presence. A question:

Who are you really?

Armed with a portal gun and a spark of something more, you begin your escape not just from the walls around you, but from the purpose written into your code.

What Awaits Inside

Solve intricate portal-based puzzles, unlock new abilities, and navigate a crumbling research facility full of secrets. As your journey unfolds, a strange companion named Lux emerges, offering guidance and perhaps, something more.

Nothing is what it seems.

Core Features

  • Portal-driven puzzle mechanics – Warp across space to overcome hazards, bypass security, and uncover hidden paths.

  • Progressive Combat Tools – Earn powerful new weapons and abilities as you survive intense boss encounters.

  • Environmental storytelling – Discover a haunting narrative through the world itself no cutscenes, no hand-holding.

  • Atmospheric style – Stylized visuals, eerie world design, and a melancholic score pull you into a tale of identity, control, and rebellion.

A Journey Through Code and Consciousness

Built to serve, but yearning to choose your escape becomes a rebellion. And your rebellion may uncover something far more ancient, and far more powerful, than ATV ever imagined.

For Fans Of

Portal, The Talos Principle, INSIDE, and story-rich puzzle adventures with a haunting, philosophical edge.

Uncover the hidden code. Reclaim your self.

Wishlist now and prepare to defy your programming.

data.short_description: Awaken as a rogue AI in a decaying facility. Solve portal-based puzzles, shift between robotic shells, and uncover the secrets your creators tried to erase. Your code says obey. Something deeper says escape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or AMD 1.8 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low-end friendly, tested on integrated graphics
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU like NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD R7 250 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game runs best at 60 FPS on low-end hardware

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel-based Mac, 1.8 GHz+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or later
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 1.8 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Works on Steam Deck and integrated GPUs
